div.div:
The worker writes a receipt to S3 and marks the sale PROCESSED; it is idempotent and only consumes while its region is ACTIVE.
Every ECS service: Fargate · auto scaling on CPU · rollback on a failed deploy · Service Connect between apps · logs in CloudWatch
